featured_reviews.review_text: My friend had stayed at this hostel for a few months. This is the worst place to stay in this area. The worst part is the owners are completely unbothered by these complaints and will keep giving silly excuses or will ask the person to leave if they have problems.

featured_reviews.name: Pranjali Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: One of my friends stayed here and this is the worst place to stay in Mumbai. Hostel owners are pathetic and rude to the girls always. Some door locks are not proper, rats run around in the dining area, fridge provided is of no use, even few fans are not working, and they don't take proper responsibility in fixing any of these problems. You have to fight with them for getting basic facilities for which you are already paying. Also, they don't even allow you to go in any other room. That place feels like a jail. Everyone is asked to switch off the lights at 10:30 pm which is stupid. They will ask you to pay extra if you want to use the lights for studying after curfew. Hostel wardens are the worst, Please do not make the mistake of coming here. I hope there was an option for negative rating

featured_reviews.name: Akhil Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had checked this hostel out  for my sister who was moving to Mumbai, but this hostel was like from the 90s. It says working women’s but they treat them like kids. The set of rules that exist here makes no sense except to save money for them. The curfew is till 10: 30 pm and the lights need to be switched off at 10:30 even if you have work or any imp issues. They are not allowed to go outside after having dinner which is roughly 8 pm. They even have rules controlling the way they should dress. They were also asking to pay extra for electricity if they happen to stay here at day time and even ask them to turn off the lights in their room. The rule to get back the deposit is also not reasonable and it’s mostly gone.  Some of the inmates had mentioned that it gets too noisy on sundays. They make up rules once you join which they had not mentioned before.
